name: Josephy Cornelhild Zondarig
original_name: ジョセフィ・コーネルヒルド・ゾンダリク
source:
"As your knight, I will become your sword and shield, and vow to protect you. I'll lend you my strength. Feel honored."

A prince of the ruined country "Zondalik", he now lives with the traveling troupe "Marveil Theater".

He is a proud man who is unable to speak well of others, and he is not afraid to talk to Cecilia. He also has an immature side, as he easily falls for provocations.

However, he always has a strong desire to revive the Kingdom of Zondalik.

[From [url=https://www.otomate.jp/tsuitsui/chara/]official website[/url]]
